Use the `memory-governance` skill to review the completed work and any supplied context: `${input:scope:Current completed task or milestone}`.

Identify only high-value memory candidates that would change a future decision, prevent a demonstrated failure, or avoid expensive rediscovery. Verify evidence and conflicts. Ask Librarian to propose promotions, archives, or revalidation; do not promote low-confidence observations or rejected implementation claims.
